rubrics.justification: The response fundamentally misclassifies the embryo as a good Day 4 morula/early cavitating morula and ignores the provided Gardner grade 1DD, which indicates a very poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerative ICM and TE. It fabricates favorable features not supported by the case.

It integrates most relevant patient factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status, though it overweights these positives relative to the very poor embryo grade.

The reasoning is internally structured but rests on a major false premise that the embryo is good quality. This leads to an implausibly optimistic implantation estimate and conclusions inconsistent with the stated 1DD morphology.

The response does not align well with Gardner grading interpretation and overestimates prognosis for a 1DD embryo. While some general IVF recommendations are standard, the embryo-quality assessment and success estimate deviate from evidence-based expectations.

It offers practical next steps such as luteal support, beta-hCG timing, and future review of embryo development, but recommendations are fairly generic and insufficiently tailored to the poor-grade embryo.
